description: Update an actor's name, description, system prompt, capabilities, or status. Only the fields you pass change; at least one is required. Set status to "archived" to soft-delete.

capabilities.description: Full capabilities object, which REPLACES the stored one rather than merging, so read it with get_actor and send it back with your changes, e.g. {"model": "...", "useBrowser": true, "memory": true, ...}. emailUsername always keeps its stored value. Omit to leave capabilities unchanged.

description.description: New persona description (background, goals, tech comfort). Replaces the old one entirely; omit to keep it.

name.description: New display name. Omit to keep the current one.

status.description: Set to "archived" to soft-delete, or "active" to restore. Omit to keep the current status.

system_prompt.description: Extra instructions layered on the persona, replacing any existing ones, at most 1000 characters. Put facts, processes and expertise in actor knowledge instead. Omit to keep the current prompt.

name: update_actor

capabilities.description: Capability settings as a JSON object: model, temperature, maxTokens, emailUsername (the inbox address, assigned when the actor is created and never changed), and switches such as useBrowser, receiveEmail, webSearch and memory. receiveSms is on while the actor holds a phone number for text message codes (Startup and above); numbers are given to an actor in the dashboard, not by this tool, so setting receiveSms here does not give it one.

status.description: Lifecycle state: "active" actors can run; "archived" ones are soft-deleted.

title: Update actor
